Explain B-Tree index structure in PostgreSQL and when to use GIN indexes instead.

B-Tree indexes are the default index type in PostgreSQL, ideal for comparisons using operators like <, =, and >.

CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users USING btree (email); CREATE INDEX idx_documents_tags ON documents USING gin (tags);
Index Type Best For
B-Tree Scalar equality and range queries
GIN Arrays, full-text search, and JSONB
